usedFor: DitCal holds bookings and MSG91 handles tickets in Hello, so “Booking Cancelled” can run “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Cancelled” in DitCal, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled booking opens a ticket in Hello, so someone follows up.

watchOut: “Send Mail via Hello” can reply with a ticket id, so decide whether it should open a ticket or reply.
